issues.title: Define an APT binding claim for the initial SIP INVITE
issues.author: altanai
issues.body:
The SIP `AI-Pref` header already provides a way to reference an AI Preference Token (APT). Define how the STIR Authentication Service takes that reference from the initial `INVITE` and adds it to the signed PASSporT payload. Start with one HTTPS-referenced APT and an optional claim in a full-form PASSporT, following the Rich Call Data claims-only precedent. [Real-Time Bindings §5.1](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-altanai-aipref-realtime-protocol-bindings#section-5.1), [RFC 9795 §13](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9795.html#section-13)

- [ ] Specify how the Authentication Service obtains the serialized APT, computes its digest, adds the claim, and signs the PASSporT carried in the SIP `Identity` header.
- [ ] Define the candidate claim fields (APT identifier, HTTPS URI, version, scope, and digest). Specify exactly which bytes are hashed, how the digest is encoded, and which fields must match the `AI-Pref` header.
- [ ] Define what binds the claim to this particular `INVITE`. Evaluate whether `orig`, `dest`, and `iat` are sufficient or whether the binding also needs request context such as `Call-ID` and the `From` tag.
- [ ] Specify what the STIR signer attests about the attachment and how the receiver separately verifies the APT issuer’s authority over the scoped data.

issues.title: Add an end-to-end no-training example for call audio
issues.author: altanai
issues.body:
Use the binding from #1 to show a caller expressing `train-ai=n` for a specified audio stream from the call. The example should show how the receiving side verifies the preference during call setup and associates the result with any recording of that stream. [AIPREF Vocabulary §§4.1, 6](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-ietf-aipref-vocab#section-4.1), [Real-Time Bindings §9.1.5](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-altanai-aipref-realtime-protocol-bindings#section-9.1.5)

- [ ] Include the APT bytes, expected digest, SIP `INVITE` with `AI-Pref` and `Identity`, and decoded PASSporT payload so an implementer can reproduce the check.
- [ ] Show the receiver verifying the STIR signature, matching the reference and digest, and checking the APT issuer and audio scope before passing the verified preference to the recording application.
- [ ] Document outcomes for a valid binding, changed APT bytes, a mismatched scope or version, an unauthorized issuer, and a missing or unsupported claim. Report call identity and preference verification separately. A missing or unsupported preference leaves training permission unknown.
